author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Whitened: Batch-Center Recenter η=0.10 (k=45)
abstract: Stronger batch-center recentering (η=0.10) on graph PCs prior to balanced kNN; otherwise identical to the frozen default. Acceptance only if mean improves or label metrics rise with mixing unchanged.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from praxis.dual_whitened_adaptpc_recenter import run_pipeline_recenter
import anndata as ad

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
    return run_pipeline_recenter(adata,
                                 n_pcs_emb=64, alpha=0.95,
                                 n_pcs_graph=50, gamma_max=0.74, lam=0.9, l2=1e-3,
                                 k_total=45, metric='cosine', recenter_eta=0.10)
